blocks.text: INDIANAPOLIS — LeBron James had 21 points, seven rebounds and six assists, and the Philadelphia 76ers breezed past the Indiana Pacers 111-87 on Friday night to win East Group B and advance to the knockout round of the NBA Cup. The Sixers will play at East Group C winner Atlanta next week in the quarterfinals of the NBA’s in-season tournament. Joel Embiid added 14 points and 11 rebounds for the Eastern Conference-leading Sixers (16-4), who have won seven of eight.
